_comment: Non-secret router settings. The IMAP password lives in the macOS Keychain (service below), the API key in ~/.config/claude-secrets/claude.env. Never put either here.

imap._note: Since 19 Oct 2026. Before: atendimento@lebillet.eu on srv6.mychrome.pt (Keychain lebillet-imap), state in ~/lebillet-data/router, kept as practice data. SMTP: same host, port 465.

pricing._note: Claude list prices in USD per million tokens (cache_write = 5-minute TTL, 1.25x input), from Anthropic's model table cached 2026-10-06. usd_to_eur = 1/1.1539, the ECB reference rate of 15 Sep 2026 (via Banca d'Italia). Update both when prices or the rate change.

webapp._note: The dashboard (src/webapp.py) listens on 127.0.0.1 only and asks everyone to log in (python3 src/webapp.py --set-password admin|agent). hosts = the server's tailnet name (e.g. tickett-router.tailXXXX.ts.net). secure_cookie = true behind https; trusted_proxy = true to lock out by the X-Forwarded-For address.

_handoff_note: Mail a person must answer: refunds Tickett handles, questions the sources cannot answer, legal mail. Follow-ups in those conversations land here too.
_answered_note: Mail you reply to (seen in Sent) moves here. Customer follow-ups go back to the conversation's category folder.

drafts._note: true = write a reply draft for new customer mail in folders 1-7. Rules in config/rulebook.md.

_route_since_note: The router only touches mail that arrived on or after this date; older mail is filed by the backfill.

rules._note: Used when there is no API key. Measured on 360 hand-labelled cases: cancelled-event refunds 98%, merch 95% agreement. Add new cancelled events here.
